dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew... Lantern Rite is such a tiring time. I should take a moment to rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But the moment I stop, the anxiety just hits me all over again...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Can I really take slack off while watching Lady Keqing hurry this way and that, making the Lantern Rite preparations?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I can't stand it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: My work with the Ministry of Civil Affairs has really been piling up recently. Right now I'm assigning them to people.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I just finished organizing forms that I need various people to fill out, but I don't have any time to distribute them...

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: You'd do that? Great! It's really not complicated. Everything I need is written very clearly on the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Just take them the forms and they'll see what they need to do.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: The two most urgent jobs are those for Jiangzhou and Nervous An. Take these forms to them.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Come back here and let me know once you've delivered the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: No, it's not complicated, really! I already wrote everything out on the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: You just deliver the forms and you're done. Simple as that.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Thank you so much. I'm just swamped with work now.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hello. Can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You have two seconds to tell me what you need.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your—

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Role? Clerk at the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Name? Ask me again after my shift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to—

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Take a proficiency test? Declare a tax liability? Apply for an exit permit? Rent a mooring space?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Which service do you require?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hurry up! And then hurry up some more!

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You're taking too long! Sorry, can't afford to waste precious time on people like...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: ...Never mind, no time. Next customer, please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good—

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Next time, prepare first!

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Whew... As soon as I stop working, the anxiety just hits me...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Hello? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anxiety?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Yeah. Do you ever feel like there just aren't enough hours in the day?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: That feeling of... I'm enjoying myself, but I can't fully relax because there is still that thing at the back of my mind... But then, you still can't force yourself to go and deal with the thing...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: *sigh* People are strange creatures. We know full well that time is limited, but we still kid ourselves by saying things like, "Oh, surely just a bit longer can't hurt..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's bothering you?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: You'll laugh at me if I tell you, but... Well, my dream is to work my way up and become one of the Qixing one day. Someone big and successful.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I know it sounds ridiculous, the idea of starting as a minor clerk and somehow ending up as one of the Qixing...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But if I don't at least try, none of my dreams will ever become reality.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Zhao, there's no time to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: ...Aah, what am I doing here then!? I must get back to work!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really do work hard.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: If I want to become a member of the Liyue Qixing, this work-rate is just what is expected of me, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: ...And honestly, I'm not working anywhere near hard enough.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I've had to travel to Yuehai Pavilion many times in order to settle some matters. Every time I go there, I can see Miss Ganyu doing overtime work.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is because she works directly for the Qixing at Yuehai Pavilion, while I'm just a small-time clerk...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Argh.. No, I have to work harder!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Back to it? Goodness, you're so hardworking...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I should get back too, I can't keep wasting time here...
